svg.aria-label: Close-up map of Chennai showing the three St Thomas shrines: San Thome Basilica over his tomb in Mylapore, Little Mount where he lived and prayed, and St Thomas Mount, the Big Mount, where tradition places his martyrdom
svg.title: Close-up map of Chennai showing the three St Thomas shrines: San Thome Basilica over his tomb in Mylapore, Little Mount where he lived and prayed, and St Thomas Mount, the Big Mount, where tradition places his martyrdom

g.text: Little Mount (Chinnamalai): the cave where he prayed
St Thomas Mount, the "Big Mount" (Parangimalai): his martyrdom
Tradition: he fled from Little Mount to the Mount
His body carried to the tomb at Mylapore
